prompt: The attached image is the approved master of this exact character with his spear: keep EXACTLY the same face, hair, armour, colours, proportions, body size and spear design, but draw him in a different pose and view. Single game hero sprite: A proud, powerful, mature male spear-warrior of the Crescent Crane order, drawn as a chunky heroic cartoon character about 3 heads tall: a BIG head about one third of the whole figure height, a massive barrel chest, huge round shoulders, enormous forearms and ENORMOUS fists (each fist almost as big as his face), short thick legs and big heavy boots, a wide planted stance, never cute, never a mascot. His face is built from the fewest bold shapes: a thick angular dark brow shape, TWO BOLD GLOWING gold-white eye shapes with no pupils as the brightest points of the face, a small light-tan nose shape, a square jaw, and a short beard drawn as ONE mid-dark shape with a lighter highlight patch; black hair tied in a high topknot with a brick-red cord, drawn as a few big solid clumps. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. SIGNATURE: behind his LEFT shoulder (the shoulder nearest to us in a view from the right-facing side) rises ONE giant crane-wing shoulder guard, a fan of five overlapping ivory-white feather plates with a thick chunky gold edge band, as tall as his whole head, fixed to his armour; his RIGHT shoulder (hidden on the far side) has a smaller round slate-blue plate with a thick chunky gold edge band. His cuirass is chunky deep slate-blue plate with ONE LARGE bold gold crane emblem on the chest, ivory edge plates, a wide dark belt with a gold buckle and a hanging brick-red sash, and short coat tails of slate-blue cloth with an ivory lining and a few big torn pointed tips; a big gauntlet with a thick gold band and a gold crescent plate on EACH forearm (identical on both arms), and a thick greave and a big round boot with a slightly upturned toe on EACH leg (identical). The weapon is ONE oversized long spear: a straight dark-brown haft taller than he is with two ivory bands, a thick gold collar and a brick-red tassel just below the spearhead, a gold butt cap at the other end, and at the top ONE big chunky leaf-shaped spearhead of bright silver-white steel, as big as his head, with a large pale highlight shape, a thick gold crescent-moon cross-guard of two curved horns just below the spearhead, and ONE small red-orange gem at the socket; the spearhead lies ON THE AXIS of the haft (never sideways) and the two crescent horns project sideways from the haft; it is the same spear as in the attached image.  POSE: a thrust stance in PURE SIDE PROFILE. ORIENTATION: PURE SIDE PROFILE facing the RIGHT edge of the picture: his face, his chest and both shoulders point at the right edge and NOT at the camera; we see his LEFT side: his left arm and left leg are the ones nearest to us, his face is in profile with ONE eye visible, the crane-wing guard rises behind his left shoulder on the left of his body; NOT visible: the front of his chest and the gold crane emblem, the second eye, the front of his belt, both fists pointing at us, his back. LEGS AND FEET: a deep lunge, the front knee (on the right) deeply bent over the front boot, the back leg (on the left) long and straight, both big boots on ONE horizontal ground line with the toes pointing right. ARMS AND HANDS: both huge fists grip the haft at belly height, the near fist in front of his belly and the far fist about one forearm further toward the right. SPEAR: the haft is exactly HORIZONTAL and exactly PARALLEL to the picture plane at belly height, lying flat across the picture, the gold butt cap behind his back on the left, the leaf spearhead at the right end pointing at the right edge of the picture, seen flat from the side, never pointing at the camera. FRAMING: full body and the whole spear, centered, the figure filling about 40% of the frame height, a margin of at least 10% on every side.  NO effects of any kind: no slash trail, no motion lines, no glow, no dust, no sparks, no shadow on the ground. COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: ONE dominant hue, a muted slate-blue (hue about 210 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #26394F, base #3F5F80, light #7FA0C0, top highlight #BBD3E6. ONE warm family for the skin, the leather, the belt, the boots and the haft: tan skin #C98A55 with shadow #8E5A3A and light #E8B684, browns #6A4430 and #4A2E22. ONE accent family, gold, used only as chunky bands and big shapes: base #D6A03A, shadow #8A5E1A, light #F2D678. Ivory #EFE2BE with warm-grey shadow #BFAE8A ONLY for the crane-wing, and the spearhead in pale blue-white #DDE9F2 with a #7FA0C0 shadow. ONE tiny muted brick-red accent #B5472F (sash, tassel, cord) and ONE small red-orange gem; the glowing eyes in warm pale gold #FFE9A6. Rules: large areas are muted and medium in saturation; only the eyes, the gem and the small red accents are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline is a dark mauve-brown #2B1E22. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky heroic cartoon hero illustration, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded bean-like volumes with slight squash and stretch, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, exaggerated proportions with the hands, shoulders and the spearhead enlarged and the legs shrunk. Colour: flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones (a shadow tone shifted toward a cooler hue, the base, a lighter tone, and one bright highlight shape on top), with the large areas kept in MID values so the figure stays readable when shrunk to 60 pixels; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), clearly thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner for inner lines, with rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots of a lighter or darker tone are scattered on the armour and the skin. Medium detail only: details are bold simple shapes (one emblem, layered plates, a tassel, a gem), no fine engraving, no filigree, no tiny patterns, NO thin gold lines: gold is only chunky bands and big shapes. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
